text:
Marta: heads up, 11:07 UTC spike of mTLS failures from eu-west-2 and ap-southeast-2. looks like keystore unwrap errors after yesterday's IAM tighten.
Leo: can you paste an example log line?
Marta: sure:
```
2026-03-21T11:06:58Z proxy error: TLS handshake rejected key-id 'ephemeral-3b7' reason=KMS-UnknownKey region=eu-west-2
```
Priya: we did a gitops change to remove old keystore roles and added a region condition to keystore-reader. Rotator logs?
rotator-bot: filtered rotator output:
```
2026-03-21T10:58:10Z ERROR unwrap key=ephemeral-3b7 err=AccessDenied principal=svc/rotator region=eu-west-2
```
Leo: if rotator can't unwrap, proxies keep stale key-ids and peers with stricter policies will reject them.
Marta: mitigation choices: rollback IAM change, give rotator explicit kms:Decrypt on affected keys, or force-unwrap (last resort).
Priya: rollback first. i'll revert the PR now.
oncall-bot: incident SEC-2026-03-21-011 created. Owners: Marta, Priya.
Priya: rollback applied 11:12 UTC. rotator now shows unwrap success:
```
2026-03-21T11:13:05Z INFO unwrap succeeded key=ephemeral-3b7 principal=svc/rotator
```
Leo: restarted proxies in eu-west-2 and ap-southeast-2 to clear cached cert refs.
Marta: post-incident actions: add alert for rotator KMS::AccessDenied >3 in 5m, add CI test simulating RBAC prune, emit structured rotator audit logs (key-id, principal, region), and document regional IAM condition caveats.
Priya: i'll open a PR to whitelist svc/rotator in the region-scoped policy and add tests.
Marta: marking mitigated at 11:20 UTC after handshake rates normalized. closing when postmortem is uploaded.
